description: This file contains functions and configuration logic for managing Wi-Fi access points, including WPA/WPA2/WPA3 security settings, WPS configuration, VLAN setup, and interactions with hostapd and wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_rate
methods.description: Adds a rate value to a list, converting from bps to kbps.

methods.name: hostapd_add_rate
methods.description: Adds a rate value to a list, converting from bps to kbps.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wep_key
methods.description: Appends WEP keys to configuration based on key index.

methods.name: hostapd_append_wpa_key_mgmt
methods.description: Determines WPA key management protocols based on auth_type and other parameters.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_device_config
methods.description: Adds common device configuration options for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_common_add_bss_config
methods.description: Adds BSS-specific configuration options for hostapd.

methods.name: hostapd_set_vlan_file
methods.description: Sets VLAN configuration for a given interface.

methods.name: hostapd_set_psk_file
methods.description: Sets PSK file for a given interface and VLAN.

methods.name: hostapd_set_psk
methods.description: Resets PSK configuration for an interface.

methods.name: append_iw_roaming_consortium
methods.description: Appends a roaming consortium ID to configuration.

methods.name: append_iw_domain_name
methods.description: Appends a domain name to configuration.

methods.name: append_iw_anqp_3gpp_cell_net
methods.description: Appends 3GPP cell network info to configuration.

methods.name: append_iw_anqp_elem
methods.description: Appends an ANQP element to configuration.

methods.name: append_iw_nai_realm
methods.description: Appends an NAI realm to configuration.

methods.name: append_hs20_icons
methods.description: Appends all HS20 icons from config.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_fixed_freq
methods.description: Sets fixed frequency and channel width for a network.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_network
methods.description: Adds a network configuration to wpa_supplicant.
